s: Dine erub tabshilin ubo l' seipim: ap al pi sheasur laasot apillu kol melakot "okel nepesh" letzorek motzae yom tob, mikkol maqom im chal yom tob lihyot beereb shabbat min haddin haya muttar laasotan beyom tob letzorek hashshabbat shelleacharayv, shehare hambashshel (o oseh shear melakot) beyom tob letzorek hachol eno loqeh min hattora, hoil vehattabshil rauy lebo bayyom (ella im ken bishshel samuk lachasheka sheen od shahut bayyom leekol mimmennu) kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g, ella shechakamim aseru litroach beyom tob letzorek hachol kevan sheepshar litroach bechol atzmo, abal shabbat sheachar yom tob kevan shei epshar litroach beshabbat atzmah haya rauy lehattir litroach beyom tob likbod hashshabbat, kevan shehu sheat haddechaq shei epshar beinyan acher, umin hattora en kan shum issur kelal keshemmebashshel beod hayyom gadol, sheyyesh shahut bayyom sheim mizdammenim lo orechim shello akelu adayin hayyom hayu okelim mittabshil zeh shemmebashshel letzorek hashshabbat kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g, ap al pi ken tiqqenu chakamim shello lebashshel velaasot shear kol melakot "okel nepesh" beyom tob letzorek shabbat shelleacharayv apillu beod hayyom gadol ella im ken hinniach erub tabshilin, dehaynu sheyyebashshel tabshil echad meereb yom tob, veyihyeh tabshil zeh shamur etzlo shello yeabbedennu velo yoklennu ad leachar shettiqqen veasa kol tzorke shabbat.

Umippene shene debarim tiqqenu chakamim dabar zeh: a', kede leharbot bikbod yom tob, sheyyomru habberiyyot: ma im likbod hashshabbat asur lebashshel bitchilla beyom tob ella im ken hitchil lebashshel tabshil echad meereb yom tob, demah shemmebashshel beyom tob eno ella kegomer veholek mah shehitchil meereb yom tob, qal vachomer sheasur lebashshel beyom tob letzorek hachol apillu hitchil lebashshel meereb yom tob. Hab', kede leharbot bikbod shabbat, sheal yede sheatta mazqiqo lebashshel tabshil echad meereb yom tob bishbil tiqqun tzorke seuddot hashshabbat shelleacharayv hu nizkar al kol tzorke hashshabbat meereb yom tob, uborer maneh yapeh leshabbat umaneh yapeh leyom tob, veeno mekalleh et hakkol leyom tob. Ulepi taam harishon en tzarik lehanniach haerub beereb yom tob mammash, ella muttar lehanniach erub tabshilin apillu kamma shabuot qodem yom tob, ulehatnot alayv shebbeerub zeh yehe muttar lo lebashshel veleepot beyom tob habba alenu leshabbat shelleacharayv. Raq sheyyehe haerub qayyam verauy laakila shello nitqalqel behannachato ad yom tob, kegon shello ereb betabshil ella bebasar meushshan shemmitqayyem yamim rabbim. Veken muttar lehanniach erub echad leyamim tobim harbeh sheyyihyu beereb shabbat im matneh alayv beperush shebbeerub zeh yehe muttar li lebashshel veleepot bekol yamim tobim shel shana zo sheyyihyu beereb shabbat letzorek hashshabbat shelleachareha, raq sheyyihyeh haerub qayyam verauy laakila bekol yom tob veyom tob. Abal lepi taam hb' shebbearnu tzarik lehanniach erub tabshilin beereb yom tob mammash, shehare im hinniach harbeh yamim qodem yom tob, adayin kesheyyaggia ereb yom tob lo yehe nizkar al tzorke shabbat, velo yibror maneh yapeh likbodo. Veken im ereb beereb yom tob echad leyom tob acher, apillu hu samuk lo, kegon yom tob shel sukkot shechal bachamishi ubashshishshi ushemini atzeret vesimchat tora gam ken bachamishi veshishshi, veereb beereb yom tob harishon gam leyom tob haacharon — lo hoil kelum, sheadayin kesheyyaggia erebe yom tob haacharon lo yehe nizkar al shabbat shelleacharayv. Lepikak, leinyan maaseh en leareb lekattechilla ella beereb yom tob mammash leyom tob zeh bilbad kemo shennitbaer lepi taam hab', abal bediabad shekkebar ereb yamim rabbim qodem yom tob ubeereb yom tob mammash shakach o hezid velo ereb — muttar lo lismok al erubo ulebashshel battechilla miyyom tob leshabbat. Abal im nizkar beereb yom tob yanniach od erub, o yiqqach erub harishon veyomar alayv: "beden yehe share veku'", abal lo yebarek alayv. Veken im keshehinniach haerub hitna alayv shebbeerub zeh yehe muttar lo lebashshel veleepot bekol yamim tobim sheyyihyu beereb shabbat letzorek hashshabbat shelleacharayv, ap al pi ken tzarik leareb kesheyyaggia ereb yom tob shellipne hashshabbat, ella shello yebarek alayv, raq yomar alayv: "beden yehe shara lana ku'" kemo shennitbaer. Veim lo ereb beereb yom tob — somek al erubo harishon kol zeman shehu qayyam verauy laakila, kemo shennitbaer.

Ketzad mitzvat hannachat erub tabshilin? Notel beyado chatikat pat sheyyesh bah kebetza, ukezayit basar mebushshal o shear dabar mebushshal sheyyesh bo kezayit, kede shebbepat zo yehe muttar lo leepot miyyom tob leshabbat, ubetabshil zeh yehe muttar lo lebashshel miyyom tob leshabbat. Veim lo ereb ella betabshil lebad velo nizkar ad leachar shenniknas lel yom tob, apillu hu yom tob rishon shel galuyyot shechal bachamishi beshabbat sheyyukal leareb al tenay kemo sheyyitbaer — ap al pi ken en tzarik lachazor uleareb, kevan shekkebar ereb betabshil, shehu iqqar haerub. Abal im ereb bepat bilbad — tzarik lachazor uleareb. Veim lo ereb — asur lo apillu leepot miyyom tob leshabbat, sheen zeh erub kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer.
Veachar shennatal haerub beyado — chayyab lebarek: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al mitzvat erub", kemo shemmebarekin al shear kol mitzvat chakamim.
Veachar kak yomar: "beden yehe share lana laapuye ulebashshule uleatmune uleadluqe sheragga ulemeebad kol tzorkana miyyoma taba leshabbatta". Veim eno mebin bilshon arammi — yomar belashon shemmebin.

Veim chal yom tob beereb shabbat ubeshabbat — tob sheyyeparet hetter asiyyat melaka miyyom tob rishon leyom tob sheni, sheyyomar: "ulemeebad kol tzorkana miyyom tob leshabbat umiyyom tob lachabero, lepi sheadam mebashshel tabshilin yeterim likbod yom tob shechal beshabbat yoter mimmah shehu mebashshel likbod shabbat bilbad, veim lo yomar raq miyyom tob leshabbat bilbad — lo yehe niklal bezeh hetter bishshul hattabshilin hayterim shemmebashshel likbod yom tob sheni.

Veim bedato lishchot miyyom tob leshabbat behemto o shear baale chayyim shello, ap al pi sheeno shochet beatzmo, kevan sheim lo haya manniach erub tabshilin haya hashshochet asur lishchot letzorko, lepikak tob sheggam hu yeparet hetter hashshechita behannachat erub tabshilin, sheyyomar: "ulemishchat ulebashshule veku'". Vehashshochet haqqabua larabbim tob sheyyomar ken bekol ereb yom tob shellipne hashshabbat, shemma yabiu lo lishchot miyyom tob leshabbat. Umikkol maqom, im lo amar ken, lo hashshochet velo mi sheshshochet bishbilo — en zeh meakkeb kelal, umuttar lishchot lv, lepi shehetter hashshechita vehepshet haor umelichat habbasar niklal bemah sheamar "ulebashshule", shekkol hammelakot sheqqodem habbishshul niklalim behetter habbishshul, veken kol hammelakot sheqqodem haapiyya niklalim behetter haapiyya, vehetter hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim vehaknasa mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid veken shear kol melakot "okel nepesh" niklalim bemah sheomer: "ulemeebad kol tzorkana". Velo hitzriku leparet raq haapiyya vehabbishshul, lepi shehen iqqar shel kol melakot haakila, vehahatmana vehadlaqat hanner, lepi sheim lo haya manniach erub tabshilin haya yoter rauy leesor hahatmana vehadlaqat hanner miyyom tob leshabbat mishshear kol hammelakot, lepi shebbishat asiyyatan nikkar sheoseh shello letzorek yom tob, sheen derek haadam lehatmin chammin lebo bayyom ella letzorek machar, veken en derek bene haadam lehadliq ner mibbeod yom ella beereb shabbat letzorek lel shabbat, lepikak keshemmanniach erub tabshilin tzarik leparet melakot ellu yoter mishshear kol hammelakot shehen niklalim be"ulemeebad kol tzorkana". Veim abar o shakach velo peret achat mearba melakot ellu shehen haapiyya vehabbishshul vehahatmana vehadlaqat hanner — yesh omerim sheotah hammelaka shello hizkirah beperush asur lo laasotah miyyom tob leshabbat, lo hu beatzmo velo adam acher bishbilo, vahare hu leotah melaka kemi shello hinniach kelal erub tabshilin. Veim lo hizkir shum achat mearba melakot hallalu, ap al pi sheamar "ulemeebad kol tzorkana" — hare hu asur bekol (haarba) melakot, vedino (bahem) kemi shello hinniach erub tabshilin kelal. Abal yesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shello hitzriku leparet velomar: "beden yehe share ku'" ella lemitzva min hammubchar, abal bediabad apillu lo amar kelum, ella sheasa tabshil meyuchad leshem erub tabshilin, o shennatal tabshil shennitbashshel kebar vehiprisho laasot bo erub tabshilin ulebarek alayv, veachar kak shakach o hezid velo berak alayv velo amar alayv kelum — hare alayv shem erub tabshilin, umuttar lismok alayv laasot kol hammelakot miyyom tob leshabbat. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir bekol zeh kisbara harishona, vetzarik lehaqnot qimcho vetabshilo laacherim kemo sheyyitbaer, o yachazor veyanniach erub tabshilin kehilkato bitnay, im nizkar beyom tob rishon shechal lihyot bachamishi kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal bishat haddechaq kegon shello nizkar ad ereb shabbat veen sham acherim sheyyaqneh lahem qimcho vetabshilo — yesh lismok bekol zeh al sebara haacharona. Veim nizkar beereb yom tob qodem kenisat lel yom tob — yachazor veyittol beyado et haerub, veim adayin lo berak alayv — yebarek alayv, veyomar: "beden yehe share ku'" kehilkato. Veim kebar berak alayv, ella shello amar alayv kelal "beden yehe share ku'", o sheamar vedilleg achat mehammelakot — yomar alayv "beden yehe share ku'" kehilkato, abal lo yebarek alayv, shehare lisbara haacharona kebar hinniach erub kasher veen kan od mitzva sheyyebarek aleha, usepeq berakot lehaqel.

En erub tabshilin moil ella lehattir laasot kol tzorke shabbat beyom tob beod hayyom gadol, dehaynu sheyyesh shahut bayyom sheim hayu mizdammenim lo orechim shello akelu hayyom hayu okelim venehenim bo bayyom qodem ben hashshemashot mimmelakto sheasa beyom tob, abal im en shahut bayyom lehanot mimmelakto — hare yesh kan issur min hattora baasiyyat melaka zo kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g, veen erub tabshilin shettiqqenu chakamim moil kelum lehattir issur shel tora. Ulepi sheen hakkol beqiin bahalaka zo, lepikak nahagu keshechal yom tob beereb shabbat shemmaqdimin lehitpallel arbit shel shabbat mibbeod yom, shehakkol hen zerizin lemaher ligmor kol tzorke shabbat qodem tepillat arbit shel shabbat.

Ap al pi sheen meorbin erub tabshilin beyom tob atzmo ella tzarik lehannicho meereb yom tob, mikkol maqom muttar leareb beben hashshemashot shel lel yom tob ap al pi shehu sepeq layla, lepi shessepeq dibre soperim lehaqel, veanu tolin lomar adayin yom hu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheadayin lo hitpallel tepillat arbit shel yom tob, vegam adayin lo qibbelu rob hatztzibbur alehem qedushshat yom tob, dehaynu sheadayin lo ameru "bareku" shel tepillat arbit shel yom tob, sheamirat "bareku" hu qabbalat shabbat veyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a, abal im kebar ameru rob hatztzibbur "bareku" — hare hu nigrar achar rob hatztzibbur, vechal gam alayv qedushshat yom tob, veasur leareb erube tabshilin kemo beyom tob atzmo. Veen tzarik lomar sheim hu beatzmo qibbel alayv yom tob, kegon shehitpallel tepillat arbit shel yom tob ap al pi shehatztzibbur lo ameru adayin "bareku", sheasur lo leareb.

Mi shehu bebet hakkeneset beereb yom tob samuk lachasheka vaadayin lo hitpallel tepillat hammincha venizkar sheadayin lo hinniach erub tabshilin veim yelek lebeto lehanniach erub tabshilin yaabor zeman tepillat hammincha — yitpallel mincha veal yanniach erub tabshilin, shehare epshar lehaqnot qimcho laacherim, kemo sheyyitbaer.

En meorbin erub tabshilin ella betabshil harauy lelappet bo happat, kegon basar vedagim ubetzim vekayyotze bahen mimmine liptan shedderek bene adam lelappet bahen happat. Abal en meorbin beripot vekayyotze bahen middebarim sheen derek rob bene adam lelappet bahen happat, apillu bemaqom shemmelappetin bahen happat en meorbin bahen, lepi shebbotla datan etzel rob bene adam. Vaapillu debarim shedderek harbeh bene adam lelappet bahen, im yesh maqom sheanshe maqom hahu en regilim lelappet bahem, kegon tappuchim mebushshalim o shear perot mebushshalim sheyyesh meqomot sheen melappetin bahen — en meorbin bahen beotan meqomot. Vaapillu bediabad shekkebar ereb bahen — hare zeh kemi shello ereb kelal.

Tabshil zeh shel erub tabshilin en tzarik sheyyihyeh mebushshal mammash, ella apillu hu tzali, apillu shaluq (perush mebushshal yoter midday), apillu meushshan, apillu hu chay ella shennikbash meet leet bemayim o bishar mashqim o shennikbash bechometz chazaq o betzir, apillu lo shaha betokah ella bikde sheim hayu notenim hachometz vehatztzir im hattabshil shebbetokah al gabbe haur haya hattabshil matchil lehartiach — hare hu kimbushshal kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman q"h, veim hu rauy laakila meorbin bo lekattechilla. Abal im lo nikbash kehilkato, ap al pi shehu maluach veneekal keshehu chay mechamat milcho, kegon dagim qetannim meluchim — en meorbim bahem, ella im ken nitbashshelu o nikbeshu kehilkatan, veal derek shennitbaer. Abal min dagim qetannim hanniqra qulyat haispanin (sheqqorin tunina"a) shebbesaran rak beyoter umedichin otan bemayim chammin veal yede ken hem reuyim leoklan chayyim belo bishshul, im hedichan beereb yom tob o qodem leken — muttar leareb bahen, lepi sheal yede hadacha zo hen muksharim laakila kimbushshalin mammash.

Im en lo beereb yom tob shum tabshil ella adashim shennisharu beshule qedera sheakalan qodem yom tob, im yesh bahem kezayit — muttar leareb bahen bemaqom shedderek lelappet bo happat. Veken im en lo shum tabshil ella oto shamnunit hannidbaq besakkin shechotekin bo et hatztzali — hare zeh gorero meal hassakkin umeareb bo im yesh bo kezayit. Abal im yesh lo tabshil acher — en leareb lekattechilla baadashim shennisharu beshule qedera velo beshamnunit sheggarar meal gabbe hassakkin, mippane bizzuy mitzva. Veim ereb — en tzarik lachazor uleareb.

Ap al pi shekkol adam chayyab leareb bebeto, mikkol maqom kol gedol hair yesh lo leareb al kol bene iro, kede sheim yishkach echad mehen leareb, o sheyyihyeh tarud velo yihyeh lo penay leareb beereb yom tob, o mi shehu am haaretz sheeno yodea leareb, o mi sheereb veneebad erubo beyom tob qodem shettiqqen tzorke shabbat, kol ellu yukelu lismok al erubo shemmeareb bead kol bene hair. Abal mi shehaya lo penay leareb umechamat atzluto sheeno chared al debar Hashem shakach velo ereb, kevan shello haya anus beshikcha zo ella atzluto gorma lo lishkoach — hare zeh poshea veeno yotze beerubo shel haggadol, ap al pi shennitkavven lo bipratut lehotzio beerubo. Veen tzarik lomar sheim lo shakach kelal ella shessamak al erubo shel gedol hair o al adam acher shennitkavven lehotzio beerubo, sheeno yotze beerub zeh kelal, shekkol adam chayyab leareb beatzmo, o yetzavveh laacherim sheyyearebu betok beto mishshello, she"shelucho shel adam kemoto". Veim hu eno yodea halaka zo vehaya sabur sheen tzarik leareb beatzmo ella muttar lismok al erubo shel gedol hair shemmeareb bead kol bene iro — hare zeh muttar lismok al erub zeh, kevan shehaya anus betauto. Abal im hu talmid chakam venitallema mimmennu halaka zo, o shello lamad otah meolam — hare zeh poshea veeno yotze beerubo shel haggadol, she"shigegat talmud ola zadon".

Keshemmeareb al kol hair — en tzarik leparet kol echad bishmo, ella omer: "beden yehe share lana ku' lanu ulekol yisrael haddarim bair hazzot". Vaapillu mi shehu chutz lair, im hu betok hattechum, kevan sheyyakol labo lair beyom tob — hare hu biklal bene hair veyotze beerub zeh, al derek shennitbaer. Abal mi shehu chutz litchum hair, ap al pi shehinniach erube techumin shehu yakol labo letok hair beyom tob, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu dar chutz lattechum — min hassetam lo haya kelal bedaat hamareb lehotzio beerubo, lepi shemmin hassetam eno noten dato ella al otan shebbetok techumo, vekol mi sheen daat hamareb alayv lehotzio beerubo eno yotze bo apillu bediabad, shehare haerub hu shel hamareb. Abal im hitna hamareb beperush sheggam zeh haddar chutz lattechum yehe yotze baerub — hare zeh yotze bo (veal derek shennitbaer lemala) im hinniach erube techumin.

Apillu mi sheeno gedol hair, im hu rotzeh leareb al acherim — en tzarik lehodia lahem beereb yom tob shehu rotzeh leareb alehem, shehare erub zeh zekut hu lahem, vezakin leadam shello middato. Abal tzarik lehodia lahem beyom tob qodem sheyyetaqqen tzorke shabbat, veen halla rashshay lehatchil betzorke shabbat ad sheyyeda beberur shehinnichu alayv erub tabshilin, veal yismok al gedol hair lomar bevadday hinniach al kol bene hair, ella im ken yadua lo shedderek zeh haggadol lehanniach al kol bene iro.

Keshemmeareb gam laacherim — en tzarik lehosip beshiur hattabshil bishbilam, ella bikzayit day ben leechad ben laalapim. Umikkol maqom, tzarik shellekullam yihyeh cheleq uzekut beerub zeh, sheen meorbin leadam ella beshello, lepikak tzarik lezakkot lahem et haerub, dehaynu sheyyagbiah adam acher et haerub gobah tepach min hammaqom shehaya munnach alayv (shebbehagbaha pechuta mittepach eno qoneh kelum), veyomar lo: "zekeh beerub zeh bishbil kol anshe hair", kelomar shehu yihyeh shelucham, ukeillu hen beatzmam higbihu haerub veqanu oto behagbaha, vahare yesh lahem cheleq uzekut bo. Lepikak, en hamareb yakol lezakkot lahem haerub al yede hagbahat atzmo, shehare haerub hu shello, ukeshehu magbiho beyado lizkot bo — hare adayin haerub hu shello kemo shehaya, veen acherim yekolim lizkot behagbaha zo. Ukeshem sheeno yakol lezakkot al yede atzmo — kak eno yakol lezakkot al yede abdo veshipchato hakkenaanim apillu enan semukim al shulchano ella okelim mishshellahem, velo al yede beno ubitto haqqetannim shehen okelin mishshello, ap al pi sheenan semukim al shulchano mammash. Veim zikka al yede echad meellu — en moil kelum apillu bediabad, mippene sheyyadan keyado mammash. Abal al yede beno ubitto haggedolim sheokelin mishshello, veal yede beno ubitto haqqetannim sheenan okelim mishshello, veal yede ishto shehi okelet mishshello — yesh omerim sheyyakol lezakkot al yedehem mittaam shennitbaer besimman shs"v, veyesh omerim sheeno yakol lezakkot al yede echad mikkol ellu mittaam shennitbaer sham, lepikak, lekattechilla en lezakkot al yede echad mikkol ellu, abal bediabad shekkebar zikka al yede echad mikkol ellu ukebar niknas lel yom tob shei epshar lezakkot od — yesh lismok al dibre hammeqillin. Veken im en lo adam acher lezakkot al yado — yakol lezakkot lekattechilla al yede echad mikkol ellu. Vekol zeh bibno ubitto veishto, abal acher sheokel mishshello, apillu hu samuk al shulchano mammash, ben sheokel bechinnam ben sheokel besakar, kegon abdo veshipchato haibrim — yakol lezakkot al yedehen lekattechilla apillu hen qetannim kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"v. Vaapillu beno haggadol im hu nasuy ishsha — yakol lezakkot al yado lekattechilla, ap al pi shehu samuk al shulchano mammash, kemo shennitbaer sham.

En tzarik lezakkot et haerub ella laacherim, dehaynu kol anshe hair sheenan okelin meissato umittabshilo, abal bene beto haokelim meissato umittabshilo — en tzarik lezakkot lahem, vehen muttarim laasot kol "meleket okel nepesh" miyyom tob leshabbat al yede erubo shel baal habbayit, lepi shehen tepelim lebaal habbayit venigrarim acharayv, kevan shehen okelim maakalayv. (Ap al pi sheen okelim mittabshil echad, mikkol maqom, kevan shehattabshil shehen okelin hu shello — hare hen tepelin etzlo veyotzeim beerubo). Abal im echad mibbene habbayit eno okel mittabshilin shel baal habbayit, ella baal habbayit noten lo qemach ubasar vehu opeh umebashshel leatzmo, o shemmetzavveh leacher lebashshel lo (dekevan shebbishat haakila kebar hattabshil hu shello, shehare kebar natan lo habbaal habbayit bemattana gemura haqqemach vehabbasar) — hare zeh eno tapel lebaal habbayit, vetzarik erub bipne atzmo. Lepikak, yakol habbaal habbayit lezakkot al yado et haerub apillu hu beno im eno qatan. Veap al pi shellekattechilla en lezakkot al yede beno gadol haokel mishshel abiv, mikkol maqom, kevan shezzeh okel bipne atzmo vetzarik erub tabshilin bipne atzmo, im ken tzarik hu lizkot beerub zeh leatzmo im adayin lo hinniach erub tabshilin, umittok shezzokeh bo leatzmo — zokeh bo ap laacherim. Veken im hu noten leishto qemach ubasar vehi opa umebashshelet leatzmah veenah okelet mittabshilin shello — yakol lezakkot et haerub al yadah laacherim, kevan shehi tzerika erub leatzmah, [u]mittok shehi tzerika lizkot bo bishbil atzmah — yekola lizkot ap bishbil acherim.

Nohagin shehamareb gam laacherim mezakkeh lahem et haerub battechilla veachar kak mebarek al mitzvat erub, veomer: "beden yehe share ku'". Veim yirtzeh lebarek velomar "beden yehe ku'" battechilla ulezakkot haerub achar kak — hareshut beyado.

Hamzakkeh erubo lekol bene iro — tzarik sheyyomar: "beden yehe ku' miyyom tob leshabbatta, lana ulekol yisrael haddarim bair hazzot". Abal im eno mezakkeh lahem erubo, ap im hu omer kak — en amira zo moelet lahem kelum. Ukebar nitbaer dekol gedol hair yesh lo lezakkot erubo lekol bene iro, ubiprat im yesh almanot bair sheenan yodeot leareb, o shear am haaretz sheeno yodea leareb, sheaz hu choba al bene iram lehatztzilam meavon, she"kol yisrael arebim zeh bazeh".

Shene yamim tobim shechalu lihyot bachamishi bashshabbat ubeereb shabbat — meorbin erub tabshilin miyyom rebii shehu ereb yom tob. Veim abar o shakach velo ereb beereb yom tob venizkar beyom tob rishon — manniach erub tabshilin bo bayyom bitnay, ketzad? Loqeach beyado kezayit tabshil, ben shennitbashshel hayyom ben shennitbashshel meetmol, ukebetza pat, ben shenneepa hayyom ben shenneepa meetmol (ubediabad, o sheen lo pat, day betabshil bilbad, kemo shennitbaer lemala), umebarek alayv: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al mitzvat erub", veomer: "im hayyom hu yom tob — lemachar hu chol, veeni tzarik leareb kelal, veim hayyom hu chol ulemachar yom tob — beerub zeh yehe share lan laapuye ulebashshule ku'".

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishne yamim tobim shel galuyyot, abal bishne yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana, ap al pi shennizkar beyom rishon — i epshar lo leareb bitnay, lepi sheen kan sepeq chol, sheshshene hayyamim hen qedoshim bevadday, vehen keyom echad arok, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"r.

Apillu bishne yamim tobim shel galuyyot asur leepot o laasot shear melakot "okel nepesh" beyom tob rishon letzorek hashshabbat, ben shehinniach erub tabshilin bo bayyom ben shehinniach meereb yom tob. Vaapillu im haya yadua lo bishat hannachat erub shebbeyom tob sheni yeera lo ones velo yukal leepot bo likbod hashshabbat, kegon shehu yom edam, vehaya bedato beshaa sheereb shebbeerub zeh yehe muttar lo leepot beyom tob rishon letzorek hashshabbat, ap al pi ken en moil kelum, lepi sheerub tabshilin eno mattir ella leepot ulebashshel miyyom tob leshabbat hassamuk lo, sheen yom chol mapsiq benehem, abal zeh sheopeh beyom tob rishon, im hu qodesh — hare yom tob sheni shehu chol mapsiq benehem, vahare zeh keopeh beyom tob shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat letzorek hashshabbat shelleacharayv, shebbevadday en erub tabshilin moil lezeh.

Tabshil shel erub tabshilin shenneekal miqtzato o shenneebad qodem shettiqqen tzorke shabbat — asur lo laasot shum melaka miyyom tob leshabbat, ella im ken nishtayyer mehattabshil kezayit shalem harauy laakila. Abal im neekal o neebad happat shel erub tabshilin — en bekak kelum. Vaapillu chal yom tob bachamishi ubashshishshi venizkar beyom tob rishon — en tzarik leareb bitnay, sheiqqar haerub hu hattabshil.

Abal lekattechilla tzarik sheyyihyu happat vehattabshil shemurim etzlo ad leachar shettiqqen kol tzorke shabbat, sheaz rashshay leoklam meiqqar haddin. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar lehamtin milleekol happat shel erub tabshilin ad achat mishshalosh seuddot hashshabbat kede libtzoa alayv im hu kikkar shalem, shekkol dabar shennaasa bo mitzva achat — rauy laasot bo mitzva acheret. Veyesh nohagin shello libtzoa alayv ad seudda shelishit shel shabbat, kede laasot bo mitzvot harbeh, shemmannichin zeh hakkikkar lelechem mishneh bisudda harishona ubisudda sheniyya shel shabbat, ubisudda shelishit botzein alayv.

Mi shehitchil lalush issato miyyom tob leshabbat veqodem shehispiq ligmor lishato neekal erubo o shenneebad — muttar lo ligmor hallisha vehaapiyya shel issa zo shehitchil bah behetter beod erubo qayyam. Abal asur lo lalush issa acheret miyyom tob leshabbat achar shenneebad erubo, veen tzarik lomar sheasur lo lebashshel o lehatchil laasot shear melakot "okel nepesh" miyyom tob leshabbat achar shenneebad erubo. Veken im hitchil lehitasseq betiqqune tabshilo beod erubo qayyam, kegon shechatak hallepatot vekayyotze bazeh mittiqqune hattabshilim, ap al pi shello hispiq lehaamid haqqedera etzel haesh ad shenneebad erubo — muttar lo lebashshel tabshil zeh shehitchil bo behetter. Abal asur lo lebashshel tabshilim acherim shello hitchil lehitasseq betiqqunam beod erubo qayyam. Veen tzarik lomar sheasur lo lalush o lehatchil laasot shear melakot "okel nepesh" miyyom tob leshabbat, ella im ken yadua lo sheyyesh bair mi shemmezakkeh erubo lekol bene hair, kemo shennitbaer lemala.

Mi shello ereb kelal, o shenneebad erubo qodem shettiqqen tzorke seuddat shacharit shel yom tob shechal lihyot beereb shabbat — muttar lo lebashshel harbeh qederot letzorek yom tob ap al pi sheyyodea shebbevadday lo yokal kullam veyotir mehem leshabbat. Vehu, shello yihyeh min tabshil echad bishte qederot, ella bekol achat veachat min tabshil echad sheeno domeh lachabero, veyitom mikkol tabshil vetabshil beyom tob atzmo, kemo shennitbaer kol zeh besimman tq"g (ayyen sham kol hahalakot hashshayyakot lekan). Vaapillu im lo bishshel raq qedera achat letzorek yom tob bilbad, veachar kak nimlak lehannichah leshabbat ulebashshel acheret leyom tob — tzarik litom mimmenna beyom tob atzmo, sheim lo yitom mimmenna beyom tob — nimtza shebbishshulo lemaprea haya miyyom tob leshabbat belo erub tabshilin. (Umikkol maqom, im abar o shakach velo taam mimmenna beyom tob, apillu bishshel harbeh mine qederot qodem seuddat shacharit, vehaya bedato litom mikkol achat veachat beyom tob atzmo veachar kak abar o shakach velo taam meuma — muttar leoklam beshabbat, kevan shebbishshulo haya behetter, kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g, ayyen sham kol hahalakot hashshayyakot lekan leinyan zeh). Abal im lo neebad erubo ad leachar shebbishshel o apa letzorek yom tob — muttar lo lehanniach pat vetabshil zeh leshabbat, veen tzarik litom mimmennu meuma beyom tob, kevan shennaasa beshaa shehaya muttar lo leepot ulebashshel miyyom tob leshabbat, veyopeh lo pat acher vibashshel lo tabshil acher letzorek yom tob.

Mi shello ereb o shenneebad erubo, keshem sheasur lo leepot ulebashshel velaasot kol melakot "okel nepesh" miyyom tob leshabbat letzorek atzmo — kak asur lo laasot laacherim apillu betok betam, dekevan shello hinniach erub tabshilin — hare yom shabbat etzlo keyom chol, vekol dabar sheasur laasot o lehakin miyyom tob lechol kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g — asur lo laasot o lehakin miyyom tob leshabbat, ben leatzmo ben laacherim. Ukeshem shehu asur, kak acherim ap al pi sheerebu asurim hen laasot o lehakin miyyom tob leshabbat lezeh shello ereb, veen lo taqqana ella shehaqqemach shehu tzarik leepot vehattabshilin shehu tzarik lebashshel vehannerot shehu tzarik lehadliq veken kol dabar shehu tzarik lehakin miyyom tob leshabbat yitten bemattana gemura leadam acher sheereb, vehu opeh umebashshel umadliq et hannerot umekin kol tzorke shabbat lezeh shello ereb. Vehu sheyyiqneh et hammattana beqinyan gamur kegon bimshika letok beto o behagbaha tepach apillu betok beto shel hannoten.

Veim en sham adam acher sheereb sheyyukal lehaqnot lo qimcho vetabshilo venerotayv, o apillu sheyyesh adam sheereb veeno rotzeh lehaqnot lo — hittiru lo chakamim lehakin kol tzorke shabbat betzimtzum kede chayyayv, mishshum kebod shabbat, dehaynu sheyyopeh lo pat achat, vibashshel lo qedera achat, veyadliq lo ner echad sheyyokal etzlo. Abal becheder sheeno okel sham asur lo lehadliq sham ner letzorek hashshabbat, abal muttar lo lelek letok hacheder mibbeod yom samuk lachasheka lechappes ezeh dabar veyolik immo ner doleq veyannichennu sham sheyyihyeh doleq sham beshabbat, millebad ner echad haddoleq bebeto shehittiru lo chakamim lehadliqo letzorek hashshabbat mippene shelom bayit, shello yokal bachasheka, vaapillu belo akila en shelom bayit belo ner.

Kebar nitbaer deen erube tabshilin mattir laasot melakot "okel nepesh" miyyom tob leshabbat ella mishshum shemmin hattora en kan issur baasiyyat melaka zo, hoil vehi reuya lo lebo bayyom im hayu mizdammenim lo orechim shello akelu adayin hayyom. Lepikak mi shemmitanneh mechamat nidro beyom tob shechal beereb shabbat, kevan sheasur lo laasot shum melaka letzorek akila ushetiyya shel acherim apillu yoklu veyishto bo bayyom kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h — en erub tabshilin moil lo sheyyehe muttar lo beatzmo laasot melaka beyom tob letzorek akila ushetiyya shel shabbat, ella moil lo erub tabshilin leinyan sheanshe beto o acherim sheerebu yihyu muttarim laasot lo kol melakot shelletzorek akila ushetiyya shel shabbat.
